strategy_roster.name: NASDAQ 100 Peak Hours
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,9) and ema(close,9) > ema(close,21) and roc(ema(close,9),3) > 0 and roc(ema(close,21),10) > 0 and rsi(close,14) > 50 and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: All documented filters are used: short EMA 9 over long EMA 21, rising EMAs as positive ROC, RSI(14) above 50, and a volume-weighted-average proxy as close above SMA(20). Peak-session hours and the ATR trailing/break-even and Time-Exit-Bars 20 rules need intraday clock and position state, so the exit is the documented EMA-reversal/time-based exit proxy.

strategy_roster.name: High Yield Spread Strategy with SMA Filter
strategy_roster.notes: The external high-yield spread or VIX series is unavailable, so a standardized 50-bar deviation of price stands in for "spread beyond threshold 5" (0.5 in z-score units) and the documented SmaLength 50 filter is kept literally. The HoldingPeriod 5 close-out needs position-age state, and the doc states no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Precipice
strategy_roster.notes: The EA uses no market structure or indicators and simply flips a coin each finished candle, so a deterministic DSL signal cannot be derived and the impossible negative-price guard is used. The symmetric 100-pip stop and target are price-distance fields the engine cannot express as percentages.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Aggressive Scalp Simple
strategy_roster.notes: The MACD histogram is written as macd minus macd_signal and must cross zero while price sits above the documented 50-period EMA; the opposite histogram cross is the momentum-reversal exit. MACD lengths are not documented so 12/26/9 is an explicit default, and no stops are mentioned.

strategy_roster.name: Daydream Channel Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The documented contrarian long is a close below the prior 25-bar lower band (current bar excluded via the _prev variants) and the short-side condition doubles as the exit that flattens the long. TakeProfitPips 50 is a pip distance, not a percentage, and the 1-hour timeframe is not configurable here.

strategy_roster.name: 2:45 AM Candle Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The specific 02:45 reference candle cannot be isolated without a clock, so the immediately preceding bar's high/low stand in for it and the opposite violation ends the position (the end-of-window exit). TargetHour/TargetMinute, LookForwardBars 2 and the 45-minute series are session-dependent and unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Breakdown Level Day
strategy_roster.notes: The pending buy stop above the session range (Delta 0) becomes a break above the previous bar's high, with the mirrored break the exit. OrderTime, tick-denominated stop/target/break-even/trailing and Volume are order-book features the signal DSL cannot carry.

strategy_roster.name: Trade on Qualified RSI
strategy_roster.notes: The contrarian long is RSI(28) below the documented LowerThreshold 45 with the prior CountBars 5 readings also below it, encoded through bars_since; the mirrored qualification closes the trade. StopLossPoints 21 is a price-step distance and the trailing management needs position state.

strategy_roster.name: Correlation Arrays
strategy_roster.notes: The document explicitly describes an analysis-only correlation matrix logger that places no trades, so the impossible negative-price guard is used instead of inventing a signal. Multi-security correlation windows and the +/-0.3/0.5/0.7 logging thresholds have no single-series equivalent.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Bollinger Bands
strategy_roster.notes: Fully documented parameters are used: RsiPeriod 20, BollingerPeriod 20 with width 2, RsiOversold 30 and RsiOverbought 70, with the opposite condition acting as the reversal exit. The 15-minute timeframe is not configurable and the docs state no stops.
